q: What should I include in a quote request?
a: The product or where the sticker will be used, the size in inches, the quantity, the finish if you have a preference, and your artwork or a description of it. The more of that you include, the sooner the quote comes back with a firm price instead of questions.

q: How quickly do you reply to quote requests?
a: Within one business day, usually the same day for requests sent before mid-afternoon Arizona time. Complex jobs with several materials or sizes can take a little longer because we price each run separately.

q: Can I upload artwork with my enquiry?
a: Yes. The form accepts PDF, AI, EPS, SVG, PNG, JPG, WEBP and ZIP files up to 10 MB. Larger files can be sent by email or a sharing link after we reply. Artwork is optional at the quote stage; a description is enough to get a price.

q: Do you take orders by phone?
a: You can call (503) 461-4788 to discuss a job, but we confirm every order by email so the size, quantity, material and proof are in writing. That record is what protects you if anything about the delivered stickers differs from what was agreed.

Weekdays, Arizona time. Enquiries sent outside those hours are answered the next business day. Production and shipping also run on business days, which is why turnaround and delivery times are quoted in business days rather than calendar days.

q: Can I visit the Phoenix office to see samples?
a: The address at 3409 N 7th Ave Unit #529 is an office and mailing address rather than a showroom. Samples are sent by post instead: request a sample pack on the form and tell us which materials you are comparing.

q: How do I follow up on a quote I already received?
a: Reply to the quote email so the thread stays together, or call with the quote reference. Quotes are valid for 30 days. To proceed, reply with approval and we send a proof; to change something, say what and we revise the price.

q: Can you reach me on WhatsApp?
a: Yes. The WhatsApp button on every page opens a chat with the same team that answers email, and it is the fastest route for a quick question about a file or a delivery. Orders and proofs are still confirmed by email.

q: What happens after I submit the form?
a: You see a confirmation page and we receive the details immediately. A team member reviews the surface, size and artwork, then replies with a price per sticker, a material recommendation and any notes about the file. Nothing is charged at this stage.

q: Do you answer questions that are not about an order?
a: Yes. Questions about materials, adhesives, application or whether a design will cut are welcome, and the answer often saves a wasted order. Use the message field and skip the quantity if you are not ready to order.
